responsibility: This header declares the exported version metadata strings for GCC: the assembled compiler version string, the configured package-version string, and the bug-report URL. It is the small public declaration interface used by diagnostics, banner printing, and other code that needs access to compiler identity information generated at build time.
same_name_distinction: Is the minimal declaration interface for GCC version metadata, exposing extern declarations for the strings that version.c defines and initializes from build-time macros, rather than containing the compiled-in string definitions itself.
